note.zh: 建安十八年省交州，併入荊、益二州，分屬不詳。
note.en: Abolished in 213 and divided between Jing and Yi; how is not recorded.

note.zh: 大明三年（459）揚州之地改為王畿，東揚州改稱揚州；八年（464）復舊。
note.en: In 459 Yang Province became the capital region and East Yang took the name Yang; in 464 the old names returned.

note.zh: 泰豫元年（472）徐州移治東海朐，元徽元年（473）還治鍾離。
note.en: In 472 Xu Province moved its seat to Qu in Donghai, and in 473 back to Zhongli.

note.zh: 元嘉三十年（453）省併南徐州，其後復立，年份不詳，未繪。
note.en: Merged into South Xu in 453 and later restored, year unknown; not drawn.

note.zh: 元嘉二十年（443）省兗州，分郡屬徐、冀二州，三十年（453）復立；其間如何分屬不詳，未繪。濟陰歸屬不明，未繪入任何一州。
note.en: Abolished in 443 with its commanderies split between Xu and Ji, and restored in 453; how they were split is not recorded, so it is not drawn. Where Jiyin belonged is unclear; it is left out of every province.

note.zh: 二豫州屢分屢合，此據《宋書》所記年份繪出；泰始四年（468）以淮南、宣城為南豫州、五年罷，泰豫元年（472）廬江與南汝陰互易，皆未繪。
note.en: The two Yu provinces were split and merged again and again; the map follows the years the Song history gives. Not drawn: Huainan and Xuancheng as South Yu in 468–469, and the swap of Lujiang and South Runan in 472.

note.zh: 冀州郡縣多為僑置，實土約當歷城、平原一帶。
note.en: Most of Ji Province's commanderies were displaced ones; its real land was roughly around Licheng and Pingyuan.

note.zh: 明帝時復立司州於義陽，漸成實土，年份不詳，未繪。
note.en: Emperor Ming later set up Si Province again at Yiyang, which slowly became real land; year unknown, not drawn.

note.zh: 天門郡初割屬郢州，後還荊州（年份不詳）；此始終繪入荊州。
note.en: Tianmen was first given to Ying and later returned to Jing (year unknown); the map keeps it in Jing throughout.

note.zh: 東晉孝武帝已於襄陽僑立雍州，元嘉二十六年（449）始割實土。
note.en: A displaced Yong Province had been set up at Xiangyang under Eastern Jin; it was given real land only in 449.

note.zh: 秦州（南、北秦）寄治漢中，與梁州同地，未另繪；北秦州為仇池楊氏所受，名義而已。
note.en: Qin Province (South and North Qin) was seated in Hanzhong on Liang's land and is not drawn separately; North Qin was a title held by the Yang of Chouchi, in name only.

changes.zh: 漢武帝初置十三州刺史部。
changes.en: Emperor Wu of Han sets up the thirteen inspectorates (州).

sources.locator: 卷六 武帝紀 元封五年
sources.textZh: 初置刺史部十三州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Han

note.zh: 西漢另有朔方刺史部，東漢建武十一年（35）併入并州；此處自始即按東漢十三州繪出。
note.en: Western Han also had a Shuofang inspectorate, merged into Bing in 35 CE; the map draws the Eastern Han thirteen throughout.

changes.zh: 分涼州河西諸郡為雍州。
changes.en: The Hexi commanderies are split from Liang to form Yong Province.

sources.locator: 卷九 孝獻帝紀 興平元年
sources.textZh: 夏六月丙子，分涼州河西四郡爲廱州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 涼州
sources.textZh: 獻帝時，涼州數有亂，河西五郡去州隔遠，於是乃別以爲雍州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

source.en: Hou Hanshu, Annals of Emperor Xian

accounts.quoteZh: 分涼州河西四郡爲廱州。

claim.zh: 金城、酒泉、敦煌、張掖（不含武威）。
claim.en: Jincheng, Jiuquan, Dunhuang and Zhangye (not Wuwei).

claim.zh: 河西五郡，即張掖、酒泉、敦煌、武威、金城。
claim.en: The five Hexi commanderies: Zhangye, Jiuquan, Dunhuang, Wuwei and Jincheng.

accounts.quoteZh: 河西五郡去州隔遠，於是乃別以爲雍州。

note.zh: 地圖按《晉書》五郡繪出（含武威，否則武威將成涼州飛地）。
note.en: The map follows the Jinshu's five (with Wuwei, which otherwise would be cut off from Liang).

changes.zh: 復禹貢九州：省幽、并入冀，省司隸、涼州入雍，省交州入荊、益。
changes.en: The "nine provinces of the Yu Gong" restored: You and Bing merged into Ji, Sili and Liang into Yong, Jiao into Jing and Yi.

sources.locator: 卷九 孝獻帝紀 建安十八年
sources.textZh: 十八年春正月庚寅，復禹貢九州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han

sources.locator: 卷九 孝獻帝紀 建安十八年 李賢注引《獻帝春秋》
sources.textZh: 時省幽、并州，以其郡國并於兾州；省司隷校尉及涼州，以其郡國并爲雍州；省交州，并荊州、益州。於是有兖、豫、青、徐、荊、楊、兾、益、雍也。
sources.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han, Li Xian's commentary

sources.locator: 魏書一 武帝紀 建安十八年 策命
sources.textZh: 今以冀州之河東、河內、魏郡、趙國、中山、常山、鉅鹿、安平、甘陵、平原凡十郡，封君爲魏公。
sources.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms

question.en: Where did the Sili commanderies go?

claim.en: All of Sili went to Yong.

source.en: Xiandi chunqiu, quoted by Li Xian

accounts.quoteZh: 省司隷校尉及涼州，以其郡國并爲雍州

claim.zh: 河東、河內屬冀州（封魏公的冀州十郡之中）。
claim.en: Hedong and Henei were in Ji (among the ten Ji commanderies of Cao Cao's dukedom).

accounts.quoteZh: 今以冀州之河東、河內、魏郡、趙國、中山、常山、鉅鹿、安平、甘陵、平原凡十郡

note.zh: 地圖按《三國志》以河東、河內屬冀州，平原亦由青州入冀州；其餘司隸諸郡入雍州。交州併入荊、益的分界不詳，故標為「交州故地」。
note.en: The map follows the Sanguozhi for Hedong and Henei (and moves Pingyuan from Qing to Ji); the rest of Sili goes to Yong. How Jiao was split between Jing and Yi is not recorded, so it is marked "former Jiao".

changes.zh: 省雲中、定襄、五原、朔方四郡，合為新興郡；塞下諸郡棄置。
changes.en: Yunzhong, Dingxiang, Wuyuan and Shuofang abolished and merged into Xinxing; the frontier commanderies are given up.

sources.locator: 魏書一 武帝紀 建安二十年
sources.textZh: 省雲中、定襄、五原、朔方郡，郡置一縣領其民，合以爲新興郡。
sources.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms

changes.zh: 魏文帝受禪：復置并州、涼州，司隸復舊；吳仍置交州。
changes.en: Wei takes the throne: Bing and Liang restored, Sili as before; Wu keeps its Jiao Province.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 并州
sources.textZh: 魏黃初元年，復置并州，自陘嶺以北並棄之，至晉因而不改。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 雍州
sources.textZh: 魏文帝即位，分河西爲涼州，分隴右爲秦州，改京兆尹爲太守，馮翊、扶風各除左右，仍以三輔屬司隸。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 司州
sources.textZh: 魏氏受禪，即都漢宮，司隸所部河南、河東、河內、弘農并冀州之平陽，合五郡，置司州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

sources.locator: 卷十五 地理志下 荊州
sources.textZh: 其南陽、江夏、襄陽、南鄉、魏興、新城、上庸七郡屬魏之荊州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 幽州復置之年史無明文，此繫於黃初元年。上郡已流散（《晉書·地理志》：「定襄、雲中、五原、朔方、上郡等五郡並流徙分散」），不再繪入。吳從未行建安十八年之制，交州仍在。
note.en: When You was restored is not recorded; it is placed in 220. Shang commandery had been abandoned and is not drawn. Wu never applied the 213 merger, so Jiao continues.

question.en: Under Wei, which province held the Three Adjuncts and Longyou?

claim.zh: 三輔仍屬司隸，隴右另置秦州。
claim.en: The Three Adjuncts stayed under Sili, and Longyou became a separate Qin Province.

accounts.quoteZh: 分隴右爲秦州，改京兆尹爲太守，馮翊、扶風各除左右，仍以三輔屬司隸。

claim.zh: 魏司州只統河南、河東、河內、弘農、平陽五郡，三輔不在其內；晉「以三輔還屬雍州」。
claim.en: Wei's Si Province had only five commanderies, without the Three Adjuncts; Jin "returned the Three Adjuncts to Yong".

accounts.quoteZh: 司隸所部河南、河東、河內、弘農并冀州之平陽，合五郡，置司州。

note.zh: 同書兩處相左；魏又有雍州刺史治長安。地圖以三輔、隴右屬雍州；魏初所置秦州「中間暫廢」，年份不明，不繪。
note.en: The same treatise contradicts itself, and Wei had an Inspector of Yong at Chang'an. The map keeps the Three Adjuncts and Longyou in Yong; Wei's first Qin Province was "abolished in between" at an unknown date and is not drawn.

changes.zh: 吳分交州置廣州。
changes.en: Wu splits Guang Province from Jiao.

sources.locator: 吳書二 吳主傳 黃武五年
sources.textZh: 是歳，分交州置廣州。俄復舊。
sources.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms

sources.locator: 卷十五 地理志下 交州
sources.textZh: 吳黃武五年，割南海、蒼梧、郁林三郡立廣州，交趾、日南、九真、合浦四郡為交州。戴良為刺史，值亂不得入，呂岱擊平之，復還併交部。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

changes.zh: 廣州旋即撤銷，復併入交州。
changes.en: Guang is soon abolished and folded back into Jiao.

sources.locator: 吳書二 吳主傳 黃武五年
sources.textZh: 是歳，分交州置廣州。俄復舊。
sources.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms

note.zh: 「俄復舊」，確年不詳，此繫於次年。
note.en: "Soon restored as before" — the year is not given; placed in the next year.

changes.zh: 吳復分交州置廣州。
changes.en: Wu splits off Guang Province again.

sources.locator: 吳書三 孫休傳 永安七年
sources.textZh: 復分交州置廣州。
sources.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms

sources.locator: 卷十五 地理志下 交州
sources.textZh: 永安七年，復以前三郡立廣州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 同書廣州條作「永安六年」。
note.en: The Guang section of the same treatise says 263.

changes.zh: 晉分益州，立梁州於漢中。
changes.en: Jin splits Liang Province (梁州) from Yi, seated at Hanzhong.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 梁州
sources.textZh: 泰始三年，分益州，立梁州於漢中，改漢壽爲晉壽，又分廣漢置新都郡。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

changes.zh: 晉以雍州隴右五郡及涼州金城、梁州陰平置秦州。
changes.en: Jin forms Qin Province from Longyou, Jincheng and Yinping.

sources.locator: 卷三 武帝紀 泰始五年
sources.textZh: 二月，以雍州隴右五郡及涼州之金城、梁州之陰平置秦州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

changes.zh: 晉分益州南中四郡置寧州。
changes.en: Jin forms Ning Province from the four Nanzhong commanderies of Yi.

sources.locator: 卷三 武帝紀 泰始七年
sources.textZh: 分益州之南中四郡置寧州
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 寧州
sources.textZh: 泰始七年，武帝以益州地廣，分益州之建寧、興古、雲南、交州之永昌，合四郡爲寧州
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

changes.zh: 晉分幽州五郡置平州。
changes.en: Jin forms Ping Province from five commanderies of You.

sources.locator: 卷三 武帝紀 泰始十年
sources.textZh: 二月，分幽州五郡置平州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

question.en: When was Ping Province set up?

accounts.quoteZh: 二月，分幽州五郡置平州。
咸寧二年十月，分昌黎、遼東、玄菟、帶方、樂浪等郡國五置平州。

note.zh: 地圖從本紀。
note.en: The map follows the annals.

changes.zh: 晉罷秦州併入雍州；又廢寧州入益州。
changes.en: Jin abolishes Qin (into Yong) and Ning (into Yi).

sources.locator: 卷三 武帝紀 太康三年
sources.textZh: 三年春正月丁丑，罷秦州，并雍州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 寧州
sources.textZh: 太康三年，武帝又廢寧州入益州，立南夷校尉以護之。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 陰平還屬梁州係推定。
note.en: Yinping returning to Liang (梁) is inferred.

changes.zh: 晉復立秦州。
changes.en: Jin restores Qin Province.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 秦州
sources.textZh: 太康三年，罷秦州，并雍州。七年，復立，鎮上邽。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

changes.zh: 晉割揚州、荊州十郡置江州。
changes.en: Jin forms Jiang Province from ten commanderies of Yang and Jing.

sources.locator: 卷四 惠帝紀 元康元年
sources.textZh: 秋七月，分揚州、荊州十郡爲江州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

sources.locator: 卷十五 地理志下 揚州
sources.textZh: 惠帝元康元年，有司奏，荊、揭二州疆土廣遠，統理尤難，於是割揚州之豫章、鄱陽、廬陵、臨川、南康、建安、晉安、荊州之武昌、桂陽、安成，合十郡，因江水之名而置江州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 建安、晉安二郡在漢會稽郡南部，此以閩中一帶代之；武昌郡以江夏南部代之。
note.en: Jian'an and Jin'an are drawn as the Minzhong area of Han Kuaiji, and Wuchang as southern Jiangxia.

changes.zh: 晉復置寧州。
changes.en: Jin restores Ning Province.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 寧州
sources.textZh: 太安二年，惠帝復置寧州，又分建寧以西七縣別立爲益州郡。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

changes.zh: 晉分荊州、江州八郡置湘州。
changes.en: Jin forms Xiang Province from eight commanderies of Jing and Jiang.

sources.locator: 卷五 懷帝紀 永嘉元年
sources.textZh: 分荊州、江州八郡爲湘州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin (annals)

sources.locator: 卷十五 地理志下 荊州
sources.textZh: 懷帝又分長沙、衡陽、湘東、零陵、邵陵、桂陽及廣州之始安、始興、臨賀九郡置湘州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 紀稱八郡，志稱九郡（含廣州三郡）；廣州三郡未分繪。
note.en: The annals say eight commanderies, the treatise nine (with three from Guang); the Guang part is not drawn.

changes.zh: 唐太宗分天下為十道。
changes.en: Emperor Taizong of Tang divides the realm into ten circuits (道).

sources.locator: 卷三十七 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 太宗元年，始命併省，又因山川形便，分天下為十道：一曰關內，二曰河南，三曰河東，四曰河北，五曰山南，六曰隴右，七曰淮南，八曰江南，九曰劍南，十曰嶺南。
sources.sourceEn: New Book of Tang, Treatise on Geography (Ouyang Xiu et al., 1060)

note.zh: 各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 唐玄宗分山南、江南為東西道，增置黔中道及京畿、都畿，為十五道。
changes.en: Emperor Xuanzong splits Shannan and Jiangnan into East and West and adds Qianzhong, Jingji and Duji: fifteen circuits.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 開元二十一年，又因十道分山南、江南為東、西道，增置黔中道及京畿、都畿，置十五採訪使，檢察如漢刺史之職。
sources.sourceEn: New Book of Tang, Treatise on Geography (Ouyang Xiu et al., 1060)

sources.locator: 卷三十七 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 天寶盜起，中國用兵，而河西、隴右不守，陷于吐蕃
sources.sourceEn: New Book of Tang, Treatise on Geography (Ouyang Xiu et al., 1060)

note.zh: 各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 秦始皇分天下為三十六郡。
changes.en: The First Emperor divides the realm into thirty-six commanderies.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 總敘
sources.textZh: 分天下爲三十六郡。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 總敘（注）
sources.textZh: 三川、河東、南陽、南郡、九江、鄣郡、會稽、潁川、碭郡、泗水、薛郡、東郡、琅邪、齊郡、上谷、漁陽、右北平、遼西、遼東、代郡、鉅鹿、邯鄲、上黨、太原、雲中、九原、雁門、上郡、隴西、北地、漢中、巴郡、蜀郡、黔中、長沙，凡三十五郡，與內史爲三十六郡也。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 秦郡之數與名目，歷來說法不一（三十六、四十乃至四十餘郡）；此從《晉書·地理志》所列。各郡轄境以東漢郡為單位比定，誤差甚大，陳、汝南、泰山、涿等地之歸屬尤屬推定。
note.en: The number and names of the Qin commanderies have long been disputed (thirty-six, forty or more); the map follows the Jinshu list. Each commandery is matched to Eastern Han commanderies, so its extent is very rough — the placing of Chen, Runan, Taishan, Zhuo and others is a guess.

changes.zh: 秦平百越，置閩中、南海、桂林、象郡，凡四十郡。
changes.en: Qin conquers the Yue and adds Minzhong, Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang: forty commanderies.

sources.locator: 卷十四 地理志上 總敘
sources.textZh: 於是興師踰江，平取百越，又置閩中、南海、桂林、象郡，凡四十郡，郡一守焉。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Jin, Treatise on Geography

note.zh: 象郡位置有異說（今廣西西部或越南中北部），此取後者，甚不確定。閩中只為名義設郡。
note.en: Where Xiang commandery lay is disputed (western Guangxi or northern and central Vietnam); the map takes the latter, very uncertainly. Minzhong was a commandery in name only.

changes.zh: 宋受晉禪，承東晉之州。
changes.en: Song takes the throne from Jin and keeps the Eastern Jin provinces.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 序
sources.textZh: 及至宋世，分揚州為南徐，徐州為南兗，揚州之江西悉屬豫州，分荊為雍，分荊、湘為郢，分荊為司，分廣為越，分青為冀，分梁為南北秦。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 序
sources.textZh: 今志大較以大明八年為正，其後分派，隨事記列。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 州境以東漢郡為單位比定，部分以縣為單位，邊界可差一郡；宋初州境據《宋書·州郡志》各州所記沿革上推。只繪當時實為宋所有之地。
note.en: Each province is matched to Eastern Han commanderies (a few by single counties), so a border can be off by a commandery; the early-Song layout is worked back from what the Song treatise says of each province. Only land then held by Song is drawn.

changes.zh: 宋初，淮南為徐州，淮北為北徐州。
changes.en: In early Song the land south of the Huai is Xu Province and the land north of it North Xu.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 南徐州
sources.textZh: 安帝義熙七年，始分淮北為北徐，淮南猶為徐州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 州境以東漢郡為單位比定，部分以縣為單位，邊界可差一郡；宋初州境據《宋書·州郡志》各州所記沿革上推。只繪當時實為宋所有之地。
note.en: Each province is matched to Eastern Han commanderies (a few by single counties), so a border can be off by a commandery; the early-Song layout is worked back from what the Song treatise says of each province. Only land then held by Song is drawn.

changes.zh: 宋初豫州兼有淮南及揚州江西之地。
changes.en: In early Song Yu Province holds the land south of the Huai and Yang's land west of the Yangzi.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝欲開拓河南，綏定豫土，九年，割揚州大江以西、大雷以北，悉屬豫州，豫基址因此而立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 州境以東漢郡為單位比定，部分以縣為單位，邊界可差一郡；宋初州境據《宋書·州郡志》各州所記沿革上推。只繪當時實為宋所有之地。
note.en: Each province is matched to Eastern Han commanderies (a few by single counties), so a border can be off by a commandery; the early-Song layout is worked back from what the Song treatise says of each province. Only land then held by Song is drawn.

changes.zh: 宋置司州於虎牢，領河南、滎陽、弘農；景平初沒於北魏。
changes.en: Song sets up Si Province at Hulao with Henan, Xingyang and Hongnong; it is lost to Northern Wei in 423.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 司州
sources.textZh: 武帝北平關、洛，河南底定，置司州刺史，治虎牢，領河南、滎陽、弘農實土三郡。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 司州
sources.textZh: 少帝景平初，司州復沒北虜。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 改徐州為南徐州，北徐州為徐州。
changes.en: Xu Province is renamed South Xu, and North Xu becomes Xu.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 南徐州
sources.textZh: 武帝永初二年，加徐州曰南徐，而淮北但曰徐。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 分淮東為南豫州，治歷陽；淮西為豫州。
changes.en: The land east of the Huai becomes South Yu Province, seated at Liyang; the land west of it stays Yu.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 永初三年，分淮東為南豫州，治歷陽；淮西為豫州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 州境以東漢郡為單位比定，部分以縣為單位，邊界可差一郡；宋初州境據《宋書·州郡志》各州所記沿革上推。只繪當時實為宋所有之地。
note.en: Each province is matched to Eastern Han commanderies (a few by single counties), so a border can be off by a commandery; the early-Song layout is worked back from what the Song treatise says of each province. Only land then held by Song is drawn.

changes.zh: 復立湘州。
changes.en: Xiang Province is set up again.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 湘州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝永初三年又立，文帝元嘉八年省。十六年又立，二十九年又省。孝武孝建元年又立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 合二豫州為一。
changes.en: The two Yu provinces are merged.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉七年〔合二豫州為一，十六年又分，二十二年又合，孝武大明三年〕又分。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 以江北為南兗州，治廣陵；江南為南徐州，治京口，割揚州之晉陵屬之。
changes.en: North of the Yangzi becomes South Yan Province (seat Guangling); south of it South Xu (seat Jingkou), which takes Jinling from Yang.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 南徐州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉八年，更以江北為南兗州，江南為南徐州，治京口，割揚州之晉陵、兗州之九郡僑在江南者屬焉
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 南兗州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉八年，始割江淮間為境，治廣陵。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 南徐州之境以吳郡京口、曲阿、毗陵三縣代晉陵郡。
note.en: South Xu is drawn as Jingkou, Qu'e and Piling of Wu commandery, standing for Jinling.

changes.zh: 省湘州。
changes.en: Xiang Province is abolished.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 湘州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝永初三年又立，文帝元嘉八年省。十六年又立，二十九年又省。孝武孝建元年又立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 分青州立冀州，治歷城。
changes.en: Ji Province is split from Qing, seated at Licheng.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 冀州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉九年，又分青州立，治歷城，割土置郡縣。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 復分二豫州。
changes.en: The two Yu provinces are split again.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉七年〔合二豫州為一，十六年又分，二十二年又合，孝武大明三年〕又分。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 復立湘州。
changes.en: Xiang Province is set up again.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 湘州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝永初三年又立，文帝元嘉八年省。十六年又立，二十九年又省。孝武孝建元年又立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 又合二豫州。
changes.en: The two Yu provinces are merged again.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉七年〔合二豫州為一，十六年又分，二十二年又合，孝武大明三年〕又分。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 割荊州之襄陽、南陽、新野、順陽、隨五郡為雍州。
changes.en: Xiangyang, Nanyang, Xinye, Shunyang and Sui are taken from Jing to form Yong Province.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 雍州
sources.textZh: 宋文帝元嘉二十六年，割荊州之襄陽、南陽、新野、順陽、隨五郡為雍州，而僑郡縣猶寄寓在諸郡界。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 又省湘州。
changes.en: Xiang Province is abolished again.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 湘州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝永初三年又立，文帝元嘉八年省。十六年又立，二十九年又省。孝武孝建元年又立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 分荊、湘、江、豫四州之地立郢州。
changes.en: Ying Province is formed from parts of Jing, Xiang, Jiang and Yu.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 郢州
sources.textZh: 孝武孝建元年，分荊州之江夏、竟陵、隨、武陵、天門，湘州之巴陵，江州之武昌，豫州之西陽，又以南郡之州陵、監利二縣度屬巴陵，立郢州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 江夏、武昌以東漢江夏郡代之，巴陵以長沙巴丘、西陽以蘄春一帶代之；隨郡已屬雍州，仍繪入雍州。
note.en: Jiangxia and Wuchang are drawn as Han Jiangxia, Baling as Baqiu of Changsha and Xiyang as the Qichun area; Sui had gone to Yong in 449 and is kept there.

changes.zh: 復立湘州。
changes.en: Xiang Province is set up again.

sources.locator: 卷三十七 州郡三 湘州
sources.textZh: 宋武帝永初三年又立，文帝元嘉八年省。十六年又立，二十九年又省。孝武孝建元年又立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 分揚州之會稽、東陽、新安、永嘉、臨海五郡為東揚州。
changes.en: Kuaiji, Dongyang, Xin'an, Yongjia and Linhai are split from Yang to form East Yang Province.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 揚州
sources.textZh: 孝建元年，分揚州之會稽、東陽、新安、永嘉、臨海五郡為東揚州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 罷揚州為王畿，東揚州改稱揚州。
changes.en: Yang Province becomes the capital region, and East Yang takes the name Yang.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 揚州
sources.textZh: 大明三年罷州，以其地為王畿，以南臺侍御史部諸郡，如從事之部傳焉，而東揚州直云揚州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 又分二豫州。
changes.en: The two Yu provinces are split again.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 文帝元嘉七年〔合二豫州為一，十六年又分，二十二年又合，孝武大明三年〕又分。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 割揚州之淮南、宣城屬南豫州，徙治姑孰。
changes.en: Huainan and Xuancheng are taken from Yang and given to South Yu, which moves its seat to Gushu.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 五年，割揚州之淮南、宣城又屬焉。徙治姑孰。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 淮南、宣城以丹楊郡之蕪湖、牛渚、宛陵、涇、陵陽、石城諸縣代之。
note.en: Huainan and Xuancheng are drawn as Wuhu, Niuzhu, Wanling, Jing, Lingyang and Shicheng of Danyang.

changes.zh: 罷王畿，復立揚州，揚州還為東揚州。
changes.en: The capital region is ended and Yang Province restored; the other Yang becomes East Yang again.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 揚州
sources.textZh: 八年，罷王畿，復立揚州，揚州還為東揚州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 省東揚州併揚州。
changes.en: East Yang is abolished and merged into Yang.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 揚州
sources.textZh: 前廢帝永光元年，省東揚州併揚州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 又合二豫州，淮南、宣城還屬揚州。
changes.en: The two Yu provinces are merged again, and Huainan and Xuancheng go back to Yang.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 明帝泰始二年又合，而以淮南、宣城還揚州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 月份不詳，置於年初。
note.en: The month is not recorded; placed at the start of the year.

changes.zh: 九月又分二豫州，南豫州還治歷陽。
changes.en: In the ninth month the two Yu provinces are split again; South Yu returns to Liyang.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 九月又分，還治歷陽。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 五月又合二豫州。
changes.en: In the fifth month the two Yu provinces are merged again.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 三年五月，又合。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 淮北四州沒於北魏；於鍾離置徐州，淮陰為北兗州。
changes.en: The four provinces north of the Huai fall to Northern Wei; Xu Province is set up at Zhongli and North Yan at Huaiyin.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 序
sources.textZh: 太宗初，索虜南侵，青、冀、徐、兗及豫州淮西，並皆不守，自淮以北，化成虜庭。於是於鍾離置徐州，淮陰為北兗，而青、冀二州治贛榆之縣。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 志云「太宗初」，此置於泰始三年（467）。
note.en: The treatise says "early in Taizong's reign"; placed in 467.

changes.zh: 失淮北，僑立青州於鬱洲。
changes.en: With the north of the Huai lost, a displaced Qing Province is set up on Yuzhou island.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 青州
sources.textZh: 明帝失淮北，於鬱洲僑立青州，立齊、北海、西海郡。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 年份約略（青州治所東陽於泰始五年陷）。
note.en: The year is approximate (Dongyang, the seat of Qing, fell in 469).

changes.zh: 分歷陽、南譙等郡復立南豫州。
changes.en: South Yu Province is set up again from Liyang, South Qiao and others.

sources.locator: 卷三十六 州郡二 南豫州
sources.textZh: 七年，復分歷陽、淮陰、南譙、南兗州之臨江立南豫州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

changes.zh: 分廣、交二州之地立越州。
changes.en: Yue Province is formed from parts of Guang and Jiao.

sources.locator: 卷三十八 州郡四 越州
sources.textZh: 越州刺史，明帝泰始七年立。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

sources.locator: 卷三十八 州郡四 越州
sources.textZh: 合浦太守，漢武帝立，孫權黃武七年，更名珠官，孫亮復舊。先屬交州。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 越州諸新郡位置多不可考，此只以合浦郡（合浦、徐聞）代之。
note.en: Most of Yue's new commanderies cannot be placed; it is drawn as Hepu commandery (Hepu and Xuwen) only.

changes.zh: 分南兗州之鍾離、豫州之馬頭等，置徐州，還治鍾離。
changes.en: Zhongli of South Yan, Matou of Yu and others form Xu Province, seated again at Zhongli.

sources.locator: 卷三十五 州郡一 徐州
sources.textZh: 後廢帝元徽元年，分南兗州之鍾離、豫州之馬頭，又分秦郡之頓丘、梁郡之穀熟、歷陽之酇，立新昌郡，置徐州，還治鍾離。
sources.sourceEn: Book of Song, Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies (Shen Yue, 488)

note.zh: 馬頭郡以九江郡當塗一帶代之。
note.en: Matou is drawn as the Dangtu area of Han Jiujiang.

changes.zh: 北宋至道三年分天下為十五路。
changes.en: Northern Song divides the realm into fifteen circuits (路) in 997.

sources.locator: 卷八十五 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 至道三年，分天下爲十五路
sources.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)

sources.locator: 卷十九 至道三年
sources.textZh: 是歲，始分天下為十五路：一曰京東路，二曰京西路，三曰河北路，四曰河東路，五曰陝西路，六曰淮南路，七曰江南路，八曰荊湖南路，九曰荊湖北路，十曰兩浙路，十一曰福建路，十二曰西川路，十三曰峽路，十四曰廣南東路，十五曰廣南西路。
sources.sourceEn: Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror (Bi Yuan, 1792)

note.zh: 《宋史》只記其數，十五路之名據清人《續資治通鑑》。宋初至此（960–996）之區劃未繪。開封府另繪。各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: The Song history gives only the number; the names follow the Qing-era Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror. The divisions of 960–996 are not drawn. Kaifeng is drawn on its own. Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 分川峽為益、利、梓、夔四路。
changes.en: The Sichuan circuits are split into four: Yi, Li, Zi and Kui.

sources.locator: 卷六 真宗紀一 咸平四年
sources.textZh: 辛巳，分川峽轉運使為益、利、梓、夔四路。
sources.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)

note.zh: 各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 遼以皇都為上京，升幽州為南京，南京（遼陽）為東京。
changes.en: Liao makes its capital the Supreme Capital, raises Youzhou to Southern Capital and renames the old Southern Capital (Liaoyang) the Eastern Capital.

sources.locator: 卷四 太宗紀下 會同元年
sources.textZh: 於是詔以皇都為上京，府曰臨潢。升幽州為南京，南京為東京。
sources.sourceEn: History of Liao (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

sources.locator: 卷三十七 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 太宗以皇都為上京，升幽州為南京，改南京為東京，聖宗城中京，興宗升雲州為西京，於是五京備焉。
sources.sourceEn: History of Liao (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

note.zh: 遼以五京為道。中京道、西京道分別於1007、1044年始置，此前其地未繪。各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Liao circuits are named for its five capitals; the Central and Western circuits begin in 1007 and 1044, and their lands are not drawn before then. Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 遼建中京。
changes.en: Liao builds its Central Capital.

sources.locator: 卷十四 聖宗紀五 統和二十五年
sources.textZh: 二十五年春正月，建中京。
sources.sourceEn: History of Liao (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

note.zh: 各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 遼改雲州為西京。
changes.en: Liao makes Yunzhou its Western Capital.

sources.locator: 卷十九 興宗紀二 重熙十三年
sources.textZh: 丁卯，改雲州為西京。
sources.sourceEn: History of Liao (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

note.zh: 各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 金遷都中都；金境分十九路。
changes.en: Jin moves its capital to Zhongdu; its land is divided into nineteen circuits.

sources.locator: 卷五 海陵紀 貞元元年
sources.textZh: 以遷都詔中外。改元貞元。改燕京爲中都，府曰大興，汴京爲南京，中京爲北京。
sources.sourceEn: History of Jin (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

sources.locator: 卷二十四 地理志上 序
sources.textZh: 襲遼制，建五京，置十四總管府，是為十九路。
sources.sourceEn: History of Jin (Toqto'a et al., 1344)

note.zh: 十九路為金中後期之制，此自貞元元年（1153）遷都中都起繪；此前（1127–1152）金之區劃未繪。各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: The nineteen circuits are the Jin's mid- and late-period system, drawn from the move to Zhongdu in 1153; the Jin divisions of 1127–1152 are not drawn. Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 北宋元豐年間分天下為二十三路。
changes.en: Northern Song divides the realm into twenty-three circuits (路) in the Yuanfeng years.

sources.locator: 卷八十五 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 至道三年，分天下爲十五路，天聖析爲十八，元豐又析爲二十三：曰京東東、西，曰京西南、北，曰河北東、西，曰永興，曰秦鳳，曰河東，曰淮南東、西，曰兩浙，曰江南東、西，曰荊湖南、北，曰成都，曰梓、利、夔、曰福建，曰廣南東、西。
sources.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)

note.zh: 天聖十八路之劃分未繪；元豐年間（1078–1085）定為二十三路，此繫於元豐三年，係約數。開封府直屬京師，另繪。各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: The eighteen circuits of the Tiansheng years are not drawn; the twenty-three date from the Yuanfeng years (1078–1085) and are placed in 1080, an estimate. Kaifeng prefecture, under the capital, is drawn on its own. Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.

changes.zh: 宋室南渡，所存者十五路。
changes.en: The Song court flees south; fifteen circuits remain.

sources.locator: 卷八十五 地理志一 序
sources.textZh: 其所存者，兩浙、兩淮、江東西、湖南北、西蜀、福建、廣東、廣西十五路而已
sources.sourceEn: History of Song (Toqto'a et al., 1345)

note.zh: 《宋史》此處未列京西南路，然南宋仍於襄陽一帶置之，一併繪出；兩浙、利州後分東西，此未分繪。各道（路）以東漢郡為單位比定其轄境，邊界可差一郡；只繪當時實為此朝所有（含名義臣屬）之地。
note.en: The Song history does not list Jingxi South here, but Southern Song kept it around Xiangyang, so it is drawn; Liangzhe and Lizhou were later split into east and west, not drawn. Each circuit is matched to the Eastern Han commanderies its prefectures fall in, so a border can be off by a commandery; only land then held by (or nominally under) the dynasty is drawn.
